root_cause.text: The AMDGPU_INFO_READ_MMR_REG ioctl handler held the reset semaphore (adev->reset_domain->sem) while performing memory allocation (kmalloc_array) and copying data to userspace (copy_to_user), and used down_read_trylock() instead of down_read(), which can cause deadlocks and race conditions by failing to wait for GPU reset completion and by sleeping while holding a synchronization primitive.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves memory allocation outside the reset semaphore critical section, replaces down_read_trylock() with down_read() to wait for reset completion, and releases the semaphore before copy_to_user. The commit message explicitly states: "allocated memory while holding the reset semaphore which is also a pretty big bug and can deadlock" and "used down_read_trylock() instead of waiting for the reset to finish."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential spurious -ENOENT errors by blocking on reset semaphore and reduce lock contention by moving allocation before lock acquisition.
intent_record.what: Restructured error handling in AMDGPU_INFO_READ_MMR_REG case: removed goto-based cleanup, moved down_read after kmalloc_array, changed from down_read_trylock to blocking down_read, and deferred cleanup on loop error (break instead of immediate kfree/gfx_off).
intent_record.how: The function now blocks on the reset semaphore instead of returning -ENOENT if unavailable; allocation occurs before lock acquisition, reducing lock hold time; error paths return directly without acquiring lock or performing cleanup, and on loop error, cleanup is done after the loop and copy_to_user is skipped.

grouping_result.intent: Fix potential spurious -ENOENT errors by blocking on reset semaphore and reduce lock contention by moving allocation before lock acquisition.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the vulnerability by changing from down_read_trylock to blocking down_read and moving memory allocation before lock acquisition, which fixes the deadlock/race condition described in the root cause.

candidates.rationale: Uses down_read_trylock() which fails to wait for GPU reset completion, causing potential spurious -ENOENT errors and race conditions with reset handling.
Memory allocation with GFP_KERNEL can sleep while holding the reset semaphore, leading to unnecessary lock contention and potential deadlocks if the allocation waits for memory reclaim.
Copying data to userspace can page fault and sleep while holding the reset semaphore, violating the requirement that the semaphore be held only for brief synchronized access.
